semanticDimensions.description: Named pharmacy or health system — use to drill to specific partners.
semanticDimensions.label: Account Name

semanticDimensions.description: Type of pharmacy or health system handling the prescription — Health System, IDN, Specialty Pharmacy, Retail Pharmacy Chain, Independent Pharmacy.
semanticDimensions.label: Account Segment

semanticDimensions.description: The commercial brand name of a prescribed medication (e.g. Advair, Ozempic, Humira). The primary cut sales enablement uses. Treat as a synonym for the generic and ingredient class it maps to — Advair == fluticasone/salmeterol == Bronchodilator.
semanticDimensions.label: Brand Name

semanticDimensions.description: Weekly observation date — the week-ending date for all metrics on this row.
semanticDimensions.label: Date

semanticDimensions.description: The nonproprietary chemical name of the medication (e.g. fluticasone/salmeterol, atorvastatin). Use when the question references a generic equivalent, or when comparing branded vs generic within the same therapeutic class.
semanticDimensions.label: Generic Name

semanticDimensions.description: The therapeutic class or active ingredient grouping (e.g. Bronchodilator, Statin, GLP-1 Agonist). Use when the question references a drug class or therapeutic area rather than a specific brand/generic.
semanticDimensions.label: Ingredient

semanticDimensions.description: Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, or Cash — the reimbursement path.
semanticDimensions.label: Payer Mix

semanticDimensions.description: The medical specialty of the writing prescriber (Primary Care, Endocrinology, Pulmonology, etc.). Use for "who is writing this" questions.
semanticDimensions.label: Prescriber Specialty

semanticDimensions.description: Internal unique weekly key per prescriber-brand-state. Internal use only.
semanticDimensions.label: Record ID

semanticDimensions.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation of the dispensing pharmacy / patient address.
semanticDimensions.label: State

semanticDimensions.description: Region grouping — Northeast, South, Midwest, West. Use for coarser geographic cuts.
semanticDimensions.label: US Region

semanticMeasurements.description: Distinct prescribers writing scripts for the selected brand in the period. Separates two possible causes of a volume drop: fewer prescribers (lost relationships) vs. same prescribers writing fewer scripts (brand switching).
